outcome: Long-term prescription opioid use following surgery
cohort: The study included 410,326 surgical events from individuals undergoing one of 14 representative surgical procedures, identified from TRICARE claims data in the US.
finding: The rate of long-term post-operative opioid use significantly reduced from 11% in 2017-19 to 6% in 2020-22 (RR 0.51; 95% CI 0.50, 0.52), indicating a clinically relevant reduction across various demographic groups.
